column4: Begin exactly at the first frame: the modern clinic facade with teal glass and the Sonrisa sign at dusk. Glide forward across the empty street toward the stone-clad entrance, ending exactly at the second frame: the entrance corner with its glass railing and the Sonrisa sign overhead.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the stone entrance corner under the Sonrisa sign. Advance and climb the entrance steps between the tropical plants, ending exactly at the second frame: the top of the stone steps beside the planter, facing the teal glass wall.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the top of the entrance steps by the plants. Move forward to the glass entrance door, ending exactly at the second frame: looking through the glass door into the white marble waiting lounge with grey sofas.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the view through the glass door into the lounge. Pass through the open door into the white marble waiting lounge, ending exactly at the second frame: inside the lounge among the grey and white sofas.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the white marble waiting lounge. Advance past the sofas toward the reception, ending exactly at the second frame: the wooden reception desk under the glowing Sonrisa logo with the white shelving of dental CAD/CAM ovens beside it.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the reception desk with the glowing logo. Turn and glide into the adjoining lounge, ending exactly at the second frame: the moss wall with the pink neon script sign above the row of amber velvet chairs.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the pink neon sign lounge with amber chairs. Move out of the lounge into the warm wooden corridor, ending exactly at the second frame: the corridor with wood-slat ceiling and the white display cabinet holding milling machines.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the wooden corridor with the display cabinet. Advance to the staircase and ascend the dark wooden stairs to the upper floor, ending exactly at the second frame: looking down the stairwell from the top landing with the wooden floor and green sofa beside it.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the top of the stairs on the upper floor. Turn away from the stairwell and advance along the upper corridor, ending exactly at the second frame: the corridor of green sofas under the wood-beam ceiling.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the corridor of green sofas. Continue forward into the sitting area, ending exactly at the second frame: the elegant lounge of upholstered armchairs around the coffee table with flowers by the tall window.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the armchair lounge by the window. Glide through the doorway into the treatment suite, ending exactly at the second frame: the blue-lit treatment room with white marble walls and the dental chair in the center.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the blue-lit treatment suite. Move on through the clinic into the main operative hall, ending exactly at the second frame: the wide mustard-walled hall with a leafy patterned ceiling and rows of dental chairs.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the mustard operative hall with rows of chairs. Advance into one of the private cubicles, ending exactly at the second frame: the yellow private treatment cubicle with the round mirror, light wood cabinets and single dental chair.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the yellow private cubicle. Glide out and toward the glazed corner of the floor, ending exactly at the second frame: the glass-walled meeting room with the round glass table, dark chairs and the city view through the window.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the glass meeting room with city view. Move back into the corridor toward radiology, ending exactly at the second frame: the radiology doorway marked with the yellow radiation caution sign beside the green moss wall.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the radiology doorway with the caution sign. Enter the radiology room, ending exactly at the second frame: the white Axeos 3D tomography scanner glowing with magenta light beside the mirror.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the Axeos tomography scanner under magenta light. Glide onward into the digital laboratory, ending exactly at the second frame: the lab counter with the two inLab milling machines by the window.

Begin exactly at the first frame: the digital laboratory with the milling machines. Pull back smoothly out of the lab, the camera drifting through the bright doorway and emerging outdoors into the evening, ending exactly at the second frame: the clinic facade with teal glass and the Sonrisa sign at dusk — the journey ends where it began.
